T~L~60~1472~0~#0000A0~Verdana~7pt~~~~comment~Q1-Q3 shunt each buffer input through R31-R33. A JFET conducts at Vgs=0, so the board powers up MUTED and R40/C16 release it after ~2 s.  SW1-SW3 are on the board, in the panel row; J6 carries only the optional LEDs.~1~start~gge1039
T~L~60~1180~0~#0000A0~Verdana~9pt~bold~~~comment~SUPPLY BYPASSING - one 100nF ceramic per rail, at each IC~1~start~gge1040
T~L~60~30~0~#000000~Verdana~14pt~bold~~~comment~3-Way State Variable Electronic Crossover  -  ESP P148, retuned, three quad op-amps, SMD build for JLCPCB assembly~1~start~gge1041
T~L~60~2320~0~#404040~Verdana~8pt~~~~comment~After Rod Elliott, Elliott Sound Products, Project 148 (https://sound-au.com/project148.htm).  Redrawn for EasyEDA.~1~start~gge1042

T~L~60~2340~0~#404040~Verdana~8pt~~~~comment~All op-amps MC33079 - 3 x SOIC-14 packages.  Q = 0.5 Linkwitz-Riley with R3 / R13 = 11k; use 11k2 for exact Q = 0.5, or 5k04 for Butterworth (Q = 0.707).~1~start~gge1043

T~L~60~2360~0~#404040~Verdana~8pt~~~~comment~VR1 and VR2 are dual-gang 20k linear pots wired as rheostats. TP1 / TP2 null at the crossover frequency and may be omitted. VR3/VR4/VR5 are single-gang 10k audio-taper pots wired as attenuators - per-output volume, not part of the filter.~1~start~gge1044

T~L~60~2380~0~#404040~Verdana~8pt~~~~comment~U3A/U3B/U3C buffer each volume pot's wiper, so the output impedance is the op-amp's rather than up to 2.5k of pot track, and the amplifier's input impedance no longer loads the pot or bends its taper.  U3D is the unused section, terminated.  R28-R30 hold each output at 0 V when nothing is plugged in.~1~start~gge1045

T~L~60~2400~0~#404040~Verdana~8pt~~~~comment~Input impedance is R1 = 47k, a line-level figure: a master volume pot ahead of the board (one dual-gang for a stereo pair, feeding both channels' J2) works properly into it.  It is off-board because this board is one channel.~1~start~gge1046
